comments.author: @BeyondTheMapTV1
comments.text: Paraguay is an interesting example of how national resources do not always translate directly into household income. 🇵🇾🧉 The country produces enormous amounts of hydroelectric power and agricultural exports, yet many families still live on relatively modest wages. At the same time, Guaraní language and traditions like sharing tereré remain unusually strong parts of everyday national identity.
